review.reason: The layout, mapped features, natural single-surface greens, and framing are faithful and clear. The mapped fairway sections read as checkered turf rather than distinct edge-to-edge mowing bands, so the illustration does not meet the required fairway-striping treatment.

issues.detail: The long fairway from the lower-right tee toward G1 has a checkered texture rather than clear alternating bands crossing the fairway edge to edge.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, the fairway reads as tiled turf instead of the required mowing stripes.

issues.detail: The small detached fairway patch near the central tee is checkered rather than visibly striped with bands scaled to the patch.
issues.consequence: The patch does not read as a striped fairway section at thumbnail scale.

issues.detail: The upper fairway is checkered rather than showing distinct alternating bands that follow its bend and cross it edge to edge.
issues.consequence: The fairway texture reads as a checker pattern instead of the required mowing stripes.
